about_the_game:
Blagmoz is a frantic, cutthroat PvP precision platformer with a fluffy fantasy exterior. Chug zany potions that unlock new strategies, find crafty ways to utilize your spells, and steal power from your opponents by sacrificing them on the Altar.

Demo Features

This demo allows unlimited online play with other Demo players on 20 stages and with a handful of potions from the full game. Unlockable content (such as levels, costumes, and potions) is inaccessible, but content you unlock while playing the demo becomes available upon purchase of the game.
